cues.text: Our good friend, Samer Hattar, who's been on this podcast before, Samer is Director of the Chronobiology Unit
cues.en: Our good friend, Samer Hattar, who's been on this podcast before, Samer is Director of the Chronobiology Unit
cues.zh: 我們的好朋友薩默·哈塔爾（Samer Hattar）以前曾參加過這個播客，薩默是時間生物學部門的主任

cues.text: at the National Institute of Mental Health.
cues.en: at the National Institute of Mental Health.
cues.zh: 在國家心理健康研究所。

cues.text: Well, he's absolutely obsessive about this light stuff and avoiding light at night.
cues.en: Well, he's absolutely obsessive about this light stuff and avoiding light at night.
cues.zh: 嗯，他對這種光的東西非常著迷，並且在晚上避免光。

cues.text: In fact, he lives in what I sort of joke, it's like a cave at night
cues.en: In fact, he lives in what I sort of joke, it's like a cave at night
cues.zh: 事實上，他住在我開玩笑的地方，就像夜晚的洞穴

cues.text: from 9:00 PM until 5:00 AM, which is really his kind of sleep cycle,
cues.en: from 9:00 PM until 5:00 AM, which is really his kind of sleep cycle,
cues.zh: 從晚上 9:00 到凌晨 5:00，這確實是他的睡眠週期，

cues.text: he has his house so dark that you'd be lucky to be able to find a spoon
cues.en: he has his house so dark that you'd be lucky to be able to find a spoon
cues.zh: 他的房子太黑了，你能找到一把湯匙就很幸運了

cues.text: in the kitchen.
cues.en: in the kitchen.
cues.zh: 在廚房裡。

cues.text: In fact, you'd be lucky to find your way down the hallway, if you're me.
cues.en: In fact, you'd be lucky to find your way down the hallway, if you're me.
cues.zh: 事實上，如果你是我，你能找到走廊的路就很幸運了。

cues.text: But in any case, dim the lights.
cues.en: But in any case, dim the lights.
cues.zh: 但無論如何，請將燈光調暗。

cues.text: Turn them way, way down.
cues.en: Turn them way, way down.
cues.zh: 將它們轉向下方。

cues.text: It will serve you well.
cues.en: It will serve you well.
cues.zh: 它會很好地為你服務。

cues.text: It will make it much easier for you to get sleepy and stay sleepy,
cues.en: It will make it much easier for you to get sleepy and stay sleepy,
cues.zh: 它會讓你更容易睏倦並保持睏倦，

cues.text: and fall asleep, and stay asleep throughout the night.
cues.en: and fall asleep, and stay asleep throughout the night.
cues.zh: 然後就睡著了，並且整晚都睡著。
